text: The intersection of Queens Avenue and Stanley Avenue in the Mimico community of Ward 6, is a large, irregular shape. Stanley Avenue is a one-way street, with a contraflow bike lane, and two-way stop signs on Queens Ave. Because of its size and configuration, the intersection is confusing for all road users and I have witnessed many near miss accidents. I have requested the intersection being studied several times for traffic calming. I am requesting a study on the feasibility of a roundabout, intersection realignment, or any other changes to improve safety at this intersection.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District to report to the Community Council on the feasibility of installing a roundabout, intersection realignment, or any other changes to improve safety at the intersection of Queens Avenue and Stanley Avenue in Ward 6.
